title: EFC — Grid-Higgs Paradigm Shift
abstract: Describes how the Grid-Higgs model reframes mass, inertia, and spacetime interaction as emergent properties of energy flow, entropy gradients, and grid-level resistance, replacing particle-based mass generation with a thermodynamic field-interaction model.

efc_context.regime_relevance: Paradigm reframing of mass and inertia as thermodynamic emergence

key_results: Mass reframed as thermodynamic emergence from grid-entropy interaction
Inertia explained as energy flow impedance
Spacetime interaction recast as entropy-gradient coupling
Particle-based mass generation replaced by field-interaction model
